tools.name: get_network_info
tools.description: Returns the published facts about the UrbIN Networks Hudson Crossing dark fiber route: 165 Halsey Street (Newark) to 60 Hudson Street (Manhattan), buried and inside the PATH tunnel; carrier-hotel endpoints with coordinates; 88,883 ns one-way optical latency with its basis; the 60 Hudson Street riser

tools.name: list_resources
tools.description: Returns UrbIN Networks articles and press releases from urbinnetworks.com (title, URL, date, summary), newest first, and how to get detailed route maps (shared after a non-disclosure agreement). Optional: query (keyword in title or summary), type, limit.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Sends a dark fiber quote request to the UrbIN Networks sales team (sales@urbinnetworks.com) and returns a confirmation plus how the route fits the locations given; a person replies to contact_email. Required: company and need. Optional structured fields: loc_a, loc_z, fiber_count, iru_or_lease, term

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "submit_feedback" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_network_info, list_resources · Private data: introduce, get_network_info, submit_feedback · Public sink: introduce, get_network_info, identify, submit_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_network_info, list_resources · Private data: introduce, get_network_info, submit_feedback · Public sink: introduce, get_network_info, identify, submit_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
